'''''Carex viridula''''', known as '''little green sedge''', '''green sedge''', or '''greenish sedge''', is a small [[flowering plant]] native to North America, Europe, Asia, and Morocco.<ref name=fna/>

==Taxonomy==
''Carex viridula'' is in the [[Section (biology)|section]] [[Carex sect. Ceratocystis|''Carex'' sect. ''Ceratocystis'']], a [[Circumboreal Region|circumboreal]] group with around six other species, although the taxonomy of this group is controversial, and up to 19 species have been recognized.<ref name=fnasection/><ref name=jm2014/>

[[Flora of North America]] accepts the following three [[subspecies]] and two [[variety (botany)|varieties]] of ''Carex viridula'':<ref name=fna/><ref name=crins1988/>

*''Carex viridula'' subsp. ''brachyrrhyncha''
**''Carex viridula'' var. ''elatior''
**''Carex viridula'' var. ''saxilittoralis''
*''Carex viridula'' subsp. ''oedocarpa''
*''Carex viridula'' subsp. ''viridula''

There is also variety ''Carex viridula'' var. ''bergrothii'' {{small|(Palmgr.) B.Schmid}} (synonym ''Carex bergrothii'' {{small|Palmgr.}}).<ref name="worldfloraonline.org"/>

[[Kew]]'s [[Plants of the World Online]] considers ''Carex viridula'' a synonym of ''[[Carex oederi]]'', and accepts two varieties:<ref name=powo/>
*''Carex oederi'' var. ''bergrothii'' {{small|(Palmgr.) Hedrén & Lassen}}
*''Carex oederi'' var. ''oederi''

==Conservation status==
It is listed as endangered in [[Connecticut]]<ref name=ct/> and [[Pennsylvania]].<ref name=usda/> It is listed as threatened in [[Illinois]].<ref name=usda/>
